metadata.description: Hub name: the DNS label (<name>.<region>.azurecontainer.io) and the prefix of the resources. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
longarm-hub image. Pin a version (ghcr.io/<owner>/longarm-hub:X.Y.Z) for reproducible upgrades; :latest is the newest release, :edge the main branch.
Hub size: small = 1 vCPU / 1.5 GB, medium = 2 vCPU / 3 GB.
Serve the web panel and install scripts over HTTPS (Caddy sidecar on 80/443 with a Let's Encrypt certificate for the azurecontainer.io name).
E-mail for Let's Encrypt expiry notices (optional).
Caddy image of the panel sidecar (pinned by digest; point it at a mirror if Docker Hub rate limits bite).
Send container logs to a new Log Analytics workspace (about 2-3 USD per GB ingested).
Storage redundancy of the account holding the Litestream replica and the state share.
Lifetime in hours of the one-time admin join code created on the first start.

UDP port of the longnet relay (QUIC + STUN); the second STUN port is this + 1. Not 7443: ACI refuses one port number for TCP and UDP (DuplicateContainerPorts). Workers listen on longnet://<fqdn>:<port>?tcp=<fqdn>:7443 (the relay TLS fallback uses the hub TCP port).

External STUN servers the hub advertises to the nodes next to its own STUN ports (comma-separated host:port; empty = only its own). ACI rewrites the source address of inbound UDP, so the hub's own STUN answers are useless there: direct (peer-to-peer) connections need these (README "Direct connections").
Expiry of the Litestream SAS (blob container scoped); every deployment (deploy.sh re-run) renews it.
Registry login for a private image (empty = anonymous pull).
Optional Tailscale OAuth client secret for the hub's [tailnet] provider (deploy/hub/README.md "Tailnet provider").
